page.meta_description: Nagasaki was hit three days after Hiroshima. The two bombings remain the only combat uses of nuclear weapons. Related pages: Manhattan Project, Hiroshima.
page.content:
9 August 1945 — second atomic bombing of Japan.

How Nagasaki connects

  • Faction: Manhattan Project — The Manhattan Project built the bomb used on Nagasaki.
  • Event: Hiroshima — Nagasaki was bombed three days after Hiroshima.

What is Nagasaki?

Nagasaki was hit three days after Hiroshima. The two bombings remain the only combat uses of nuclear weapons.

Key threads lead to Manhattan Project and Hiroshima.
